correctness.rationale: The leading-term commutator coefficient is r*a*b in characteristic 2, so the first nonidentity term of f∘f cannot have odd exponent for a2=a≠0. The coefficient in degree 2j equals a*a_(2j-1) plus a polynomial in earlier coefficients, which recursively determines each odd coefficient and removes other constraints. This proves the affine parametrization and liftability obstruction; exhaustive GF(2), GF(4), GF(8) composition checks support finite cases but do not prove the infinite claim.

value.rationale: Finite truncations of the Nottingham pro-2 group are a natural inverse system. The theorem computes an entire nontrivial ramification stratum at all truncation lengths, establishes its smooth affine structure, and precisely quantifies the failure of finite-order elements to lift through odd levels. This deformation-lifting obstruction and all-length count go beyond a single small finite census; the count of liftable versus nonliftable involutions is a natural structural invariant.
